summary.en: AllInOneIME's own system identity, now without a logout. Your settings and keys come with you; afterwards add AllInOneIME once in System Settings → Keyboard → Input Sources (under English) and allow Accessibility again.
summary.zh: AllInOneIME 换上了自己的系统身份，现在不用注销。设置和密钥都会带过来；更新后请在 系统设置 → 键盘 → 输入法（英语下面）添加一次 AllInOneIME，并重新允许辅助功能。
